description: A sixteen-by-sixteen grid sequencer: each column is a step, each row a note, and the notes turned on in the column now playing are sent out together

params.text: Sets how many columns play before the sequence starts over, marked by the yellow line
Sets the direction the sequence travels through its columns
Turns every cell in the grid off
Clears the grid and fills it with random notes
Sets how full the grid is left after a randomise
Sets the scale the pitch output is quantised to; the last setting leaves the pitch alone
Sets the root note the pitch output is quantised to
Shifts the pitch output by whole octaves, -5 to +7
To the right the outputs line up with the sixteen rows whether or not a cell is on, which suits drum parts; to the left they carry the notes actually turned on
Moves the column the sequence starts from
Keeps the grid scrolled to the column now playing

inputs.text: Each trigger here advances the sequence by one column
A trigger here sends the sequence back to its first column
Clears the grid and fills it with random notes
Turns the grid a quarter turn clockwise
Flips the grid top to bottom
Moves every cell up one row, wrapping round to the bottom
Sets how many columns play before the sequence starts over, marked by the yellow line
Moves the column the sequence starts from
A voltage here seeds the random number generator, so the same voltage always gives the same result from a randomise

outputs.text: Every note in the column now playing as one polyphonic pitch signal; the menu sets how many channels it carries
Every note in the column now playing as one polyphonic gate signal; the menu sets whether a gate is a short trigger, a retriggered gate, or held until the next clock tick
A trigger at the end of each pass through the sequence

notes: click a cell in the grid to turn it on or off, and drag across the grid to paint a run of them
the bar under the grid scrolls it sideways; drag the bar to reach columns beyond the sixteen on show
menu: Polyphony channels — sets how many channels the polyphonic pitch and gate outputs carry
Max length — sets the largest number of columns the LENGTH knob can reach: 16, 32, 64, 128 or 256
Repeat 16 Steps — copies the first sixteen columns across the rest of the grid
Gate Mode — sets what the gate outputs do: Trigger fires a short pulse, Retrigger drops the gate for a moment before each new step, Continuous holds it until the next clock tick
Gate Length — sets how long a Trigger or Retrigger gate lasts, in milliseconds
